newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Ekran says IPO still open to foreigners.
newsitem.headline: Ekran says IPO still open to foreigners.

text.p: Malaysia's Ekran Bhd said on Friday that an initial public offering (IPO) of Bakun Hydro-Electric Corp (BHC), the holding firm of the $5.5 billion Bakun dam, is still open to foreigners.
"The 150 million BHC shares will still be made available for application by foreign persons," it said in a statement. The IPO involves the offer of 1.5 billion shares.

Ekran, the main contractor of the dam, was responding to a report in the Asian Wall Street Journal on Monday that it was considering scrapping a plan to offer shares in the project to foreign investors due to lukewarm response.
But the IPO's adviser told Reuters on Monday foreigners were still included in the IPO. The 10 percent portion to be offered to foreigners would also include major Malaysian investors.
Details of the offerings of BHC will be contained in the listing prospectus to be issued shortly, Ekran said. The stock has been expected to list in June.

The Bakun dam is under construction deep in a Sarawak rainforest on Borneo island. The dam would create a reservoir the size of Singapore and clear 69,000 hecaters of forest land. It is scheduled for completion by 2003. Ekran is a major shareholder in the project with a 32 percent stake.
